messages:
maria: Heads up — acme-inc says their tenant view lost p95/p99 lines after the feature-flag flip this morning. Panel 'Latency / requests (per-tenant)' shows avg/p50 only. Screenshot: https://rwx.link/snap.png :frowning_face:

aj: Which panel ID and org/tenant? I'll take a look.

maria: Panel id 42, org=acme-inc, query uses histogram buckets:
```
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant="acme-inc"}[5m])) by (le)
```
Now it returns only p50 and mean.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: flip feature/edge-bucket-ff -> ON at 2140000200 by ben

ben: I flipped the ff to route ingest to new transformer. Did we change labels? I didn't touch dashboards.

aj: Checking ingest transforms — the new transformer emits `service_slice` instead of `tenant`. Found transform diff:
```
- keep_labels: ["tenant", "region"]
+ keep_labels: ["service_slice", "region"]
```
That explains missing series in per-tenant panels.

maria: Ugh. Customer already opened a support ticket, they're seeing blank p95 line for last 24h.

aj: Short term workaround: reconstruct tenant with label_replace in the panel query if service_slice encodes tenant or fallback to org-level panel. Example:
```
label_replace(sum by (le,tenant) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "tenant", "$1", "service_slice", "tenant-(.+)-slice")
```
If service_slice doesn't have tenant info we need to re-add tenant label at ingest.

kevin: I'll revert the transformer label change and push a hotfix PR to restore `tenant` as a kept label. Target rollback in ~20m.

support-bot: Ticket INC-4321 created and linked to thread by maria

maria: Thanks — I'll tell acme-inc the workaround and that we're on a rollback. Please post here when fixed. :thumbsup:

aj: Will do, monitoring dashboards now :eyes:
